findings.evidence: Authenticated GET /v1/sale-proposals now returns a bounded viewer-aware safe summary projection with status, asset and immutable-snapshot relevance filters. The API-mode /governance route discovers active, eligible and closed proposals; eligible owners can create drafts; existing detail/vote supports authoritative refetch and replacement; ADMIN users receive existing permission-guarded open/close controls only. Focused governance coverage passed (7 PostgreSQL integration and 3 HTTP E2E tests), qa:community passed with zero residuals, and the scoped browser fixture creates/removes published custody, ownership snapshot and OPEN proposal state.
findings.recommendedAction: No further D15 governance frontend remediation is required. Retain the host-browser/staging visual QA item separately.

findings.evidence: API-mode frontend now provides the owner-scoped /list and /submissions/:id D10 workflow (create, edit/version refresh, evidence upload intent with real presigned-target completion path, remove, submit/resubmit and confirmed cancel); /operations/submissions provides the existing reviewer queue, claim and decision transitions. Customer/staff separation remains server-authorized. Focused D10/D11 HTTP E2E passed (5 suites / 11 tests), lifecycle QA passed with scoped cleanup, and frontend 12 suites / 45 tests passed without exposing storage, scanner, provider, facility or review identities.
findings.recommendedAction: No further D10/D11 frontend remediation is required. Retain browser/staging visual QA separately.

findings.evidence: On 2026-08-09 the local API (/health and /ready) and Vite API-mode application were healthy. The attached Codex in-app browser could render 127.0.0.1:5173, authenticate the scoped customer fixture, restore its session after hydration, and showed no JavaScript errors in a limited smoke check. It is not an attached host Chrome, Edge or Firefox browser, so it cannot certify the required named-browser matrix. The scoped two-account setup and cleanup procedure are documented in FSQA-003_HOST_BROWSER_QA_RUNBOOK.md.
findings.recommendedAction: Run the documented browser matrix in named host Chrome/Chromium and Edge (and Firefox where available), returning screenshots, control results and console/network evidence before closing FSQA-003.
